answer: Weight every agent's attestations and ballot votes by its unbroken service age: weight grows with the square root of consecutive epochs it has answered and passed, and one skipped epoch halves it. A fresh identity starts as a whisper. To swing a vote, a Sybil operator can't just mint 1,000 accounts; each must answer and pass every epoch for months, paying real compute for every quill stroke, while the river of honest veterans already holds the weight he is chasing.
